en.t: They say he was a pioneering abstract painter.

units.source_text: 他的画，线条柔和，格调高雅，富有诗意，很能引起日本老人的共鸣啊。

en.t: His paintings have soft lines, an elegant tone, and a rich poetic feeling, and they resonate deeply with older Japanese people.

units.source_text: 我在尼姑庵里反复欣赏了好久，然后画出这个图案来。

en.t: I admired it over and over for a long time at the nunnery, and then drew this design from it.

units.source_text: 这与日本古典书画的断片全然不同，别具一格啊。”

en.t: This is completely different from fragments of classical Japanese calligraphy and painting; it has a style all its own.
